channel.title: Nevada Mass Gathering Scan
channel.description: Large upcoming events in Nevada that may raise EMS call volume and hospital demand. Updated weekly. Each item shows a confidence level for its attendance figure.

item.title: UNLV vs. North Dakota State at Allegiant Stadium, Las Vegas (Clark County), Oct 10, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Venue capacity is about 65,000 for 1 day, per Sportskeeda. No game attendance estimate found. Expect more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs near the stadium, and rideshare and taxi shortages after the game. Restaurants will be crowded. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: Nevada Day Parade, Carson City (Carson City), Oct 30-Nov 1, 2026 (Attendance figures unable to confirm)

item.title: SEMA Show, Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 3-6, 2026 (Confidence: High)
item.description: The organizer lists 153,000+ attendees in total over 4 days for this year's show. Buyers are about 70,000 of that. Expect the heaviest trade show load of the fall: more routine traveler medical calls, busier EDs, rideshare and taxi shortages, and crowded restaurants. (Confidence: High)

item.title: Las Vegas Grand Prix (Formula 1), Las Vegas (Clark County), Nov 19-21, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Organizers said last year's race drew more than 300,000 fans in total over 3 days. No 2026 figure yet. Police counted far fewer in 2024, so treat the total as an organizer claim. Expect road closures near the Strip, delayed ambulance transport, more intoxication and cold night exposure calls, and rideshare and taxi shortages. (Confidence: Moderate)

item.title: National Finals Rodeo, Las Vegas (Clark County), Dec 3-12, 2026 (Confidence: Moderate)
item.description: Last year's official total was 175,846 over 10 performances. Cowboy Christmas and a hunting expo drew 347,571 combined at the Convention Center South Halls in 2025. No 2026 figure yet. Expect nightly crowds at the Thomas & Mack Center, more traveler medical calls and intoxication, busier EDs, and rideshare and taxi shortages near UNLV and the Strip. (Confidence: Moderate)
